---
title: "Penguin Analysis"
---

## Quarto

Quarto enables you to weave together content and executable code into a finished document. To learn more about Quarto see <https://quarto.org>.

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(palmerpenguins)
```

### Five Number Summaries for Flipper Length and Bill Length for Adelie Penguins

```{r}
adelie_penguins = penguins |>
  filter(species == 'Adelie')

fivenum(adelie_penguins$flipper_length_mm)
fivenum(adelie_penguins$bill_length_mm)
```

### Find Relationship Between Flipper and Bill Length for Adelie Penguins

```{r}
penguins |>
  filter(species == 'Adelie') |>
  ggplot(aes(x = bill_length_mm, y = flipper_length_mm, size = body_mass_g, color = sex)) +
  geom_point() +
  labs(title = 'Flipper Length vs Bill Length for Adelie Penguins',
       x = 'Bill Length (mm)',
       y = 'Flipper Length (mm)',
       size = 'Body Mass (g)',
       color = 'Sex',
      )
  theme_classic()
```
